title: Finish phasing out insurance duty and extend it to households
action: Keep the ACT's abolition in place and Victoria's phase-out of duty on business insurance on schedule, and extend Victoria's phase-out to home and contents insurance.
why: Duty on household insurance discourages people from insuring their homes, leaving more of the cost of disasters to them and to governments.

evidence.source: Australia's Future Tax System: Report to the Treasurer, Part One (Henry review)
evidence.quote: All specific taxes on insurance products, including the fire services levy, should be abolished.
